subject: Insurance
title: When Algorithms Decide Your Premium
description: A fast breakdown of When Algorithms Decide Your Premium for builders.

hook.text: AI now sets car insurance premiums in under 60 seconds.

buildup.text: Traditional underwriting took days. Humans reviewed forms, checked records, and made judgment calls.

discovery.text: AI underwrites by analyzing thousands of data points: credit score, ZIP code, driving record.

climax.text: AI underwriting is faster and cheaper.

punchline.text: 60-second premium decisions. The algorithm is fast but may be unfair.

quiz.question: What is a key risk of AI underwriting in insurance?
options: Biased algorithms can unfairly price millions of people
